verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an integrations catalog of 100+ or hundreds of native integrations for automated evidence collection. The pack evidences cloud connections, SSO/identity-based app detection, Jira/ticketing sync and Azure Government resource monitoring, plus custom integrations via API/CSV for unsupported tools. However, the evidence never confirms read-only scopes and never names HR, code-hosting or MDM integrations. Missing for 10: documented read-only/least-privilege scopes per integration, explicit HR, code-hosting and MDM coverage, a per-integration catalog with setup docs, and independent corroboration.
